blurb: Two aboard, a driver and a passenger shooting their own weapon; players on foot at its back resupply from it (ammo and grenades, ten times, then it is empty until it respawns)

notes.model: The owner's Tactical Off-Road Beast and its Rugged Off-Road Tire (Meshy Community, content/guns.json): a long tube-frame buggy with a roof gun, its hubs bare, so the tires go on at its hubs and it rides on them. It was the Buggy until 2026-11-11; the buggy split (owner, 2026-11-12/13: "the new buggy should be only a 2 seater, but players can go to the back and resupply from it (limited supply, 10x resupplies?)") brings it back as the Supply Buggy, the sci-fi buggy staying the six-seat Buggy.
notes.half: Fitted across the tires (as the Gun Jeep's and Troop Truck's): the body is 1.8 m wide and 4.4 m long; the tires (0.42 m radius, 0.33 m wide: the tire model's own size, 0.41 by 0.32 m, a touch larger so each hub, 0.42 m up, has its tire on the ground) stand out to 1.17 m either side and 2.28 m behind the middle (the rear hubs at z -1.86). 1.48 m tall on 0.24 m of ride height.
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles, 2026-11-13): two rows of cushions 0.8 m up, 0.32 m either side of the middle (front row z 0.3, back row z -0.45; the front footwell 0.18 m under the cushion); the wheel on the left at z 0.75. Two ride in front; the back rows and the cargo box behind them (z -1.1 to -2.2, its top 1.3 m up) are the supply load. The roof gun is not manned.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height, under the front roof bar (1.47 m at z 0.55), looking over the wheel and dash. Up close the driver sees an in-house cockpit instead of the body's own (client content/cockpits.ts).
notes.vehicle: The Warthog feel: soft, long-travel springs (bouncy, leans out of turns), loose at speed so it powerslides; the suspension's contact points are the hubs (`wheels`, `hub` 0.42 m).
notes.resupply: Owner, 2026-11-12: ten resupplies from its back. The reach point is the tail (z -2.3, the back of the cargo box, 1 m up); players on foot within 1.6 m of it press Use there (instead of getting in). Each use gives what a resupply gives (sim/resupply.ts: every carried gun's reserve full, underbarrel rounds full, grenades topped up), with a 4 s wait per player.
